cases.title: Normal recording of visited links to Global History
cases.description: Visit a standard web link and verify that the link is successfully recorded in the Global History.

cases.title: Edge case for visiting empty URL or malformed link
cases.description: Attempt to visit an empty URL or malformed link and verify the Global History handling.

cases.title: Abnormal history database write failure
cases.description: Trigger a scenario where the history database encounters a write failure during link recording and verify error handling.

cases.title: Record correct link after server redirect (Normal)
cases.description: Verify that when a user navigates to a link that triggers a server redirect, the final target URL is correctly recorded to the Global History rather than the intermediate redirect URL.

cases.title: Record correct link after a chain of multiple redirects (Edge)
cases.description: Verify that when a link triggers a chain of multiple consecutive server redirects, the final destination URL is accurately captured and recorded in the Global History.

cases.title: Handle redirect loop error during history recording (Abnormal)
cases.description: Verify the system behavior and error handling when a server redirect results in an infinite redirect loop, ensuring the history recording gracefully handles the termination.

cases.title: Normal Launch of History Link
cases.description: Clicking on a valid history link causes it to be successfully launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Edge Case Launch While Offline
cases.description: Clicking on a history link while the browser is offline attempts to launch it with appropriate offline handling.

cases.title: Abnormal Invalid URL Schema or Missing Target
cases.description: Attempting to launch a history link with an invalid URL schema or missing target gracefully handles the error without crashing.

cases.title: Delete single history entry - Normal
cases.description: Verify that a single History entry is successfully deleted when requested by the user.

cases.title: Delete already deleted entry - Edge
cases.description: Verify the system behavior when attempting to delete an entry that has already been deleted.

cases.title: Delete operation failure due to locked database - Error
cases.description: Verify the error handling when the delete operation fails due to a locked history database.

cases.title: Delete Multiple History Entries
cases.description: Select multiple history entries and delete them simultaneously to verify they are removed from the display.

cases.title: Delete All History Entries
cases.description: Select all history entries across the list and perform a bulk deletion to verify complete removal.

cases.title: Partial Deletion Failure
cases.description: Attempt to delete multiple history entries when a storage or write error occurs mid-operation, and verify error handling.

cases.title: Clear Global History Normal
cases.description: Clear the entire Global History successfully and verify all entries are removed.

cases.title: Clear Global History Edge
cases.description: Attempt to clear the Global History when the history is already completely empty.

cases.title: Clear Global History Abnormal
cases.description: Handle a database or system failure gracefully during the Global History wipe operation.

cases.title: Group history items by Day, Site, and None
cases.description: Verify that history items can be successfully grouped by Day, Site, and None according to user selection.

cases.title: Group history with empty data set
cases.description: Verify the grouping behavior when the history data set is completely empty.

cases.title: Grouping failure on corrupted entries
cases.description: Verify system error handling when attempting to group history items containing corrupted entry metadata.

cases.title: Sort and reverse-sort history columns normally
cases.description: Verify that history items can be sorted and reverse-sorted per column as expected.

cases.title: Sort empty history table
cases.description: Verify sorting behavior when the history table contains no entries.

cases.title: Sort failure handling on mismatched data types
cases.description: Verify the system handles and reports an error or fails gracefully during a sort operation on mismatched data types.

cases.title: Normal Resize of History Columns
cases.description: Resize history columns to show or hide more of the entries and verify correct layout rendering.

cases.title: Edge Resize of History Columns
cases.description: Resize history columns to their minimum or maximum width limits and verify boundary constraints.

cases.title: Abnormal Resize Layout Handling
cases.description: Verify handling when an extreme column resize operation encounters a rendering crash or layout failure.

cases.title: Show and Hide History Columns Normally
cases.description: Verify that history columns can be successfully shown and hidden via the user interface.

cases.title: Hide All History Columns
cases.description: Verify the edge scenario of hiding all available history columns simultaneously.

cases.title: Failure to Persist Column Visibility State
cases.description: Verify system behavior when saving or persisting the column visibility state encounters an abnormal failure.

cases.title: Revisit recent sites via Back and Forward dropdown menu
cases.description: Verify that recently visited sites can be successfully revisited by selecting them from the Back and Forward button dropdown menus under normal navigation conditions.

cases.title: Back and Forward dropdown menu when no history exists
cases.description: Verify the behavior of the Back and Forward button dropdown menus when there is no prior navigation history (edge condition).

cases.title: Back and Forward dropdown menu failure handling
cases.description: Verify system behavior and error handling when attempting to use the Back and Forward dropdown menus while the navigation state is corrupt (abnormal condition).

cases.title: Create New Empty Session History File Normally
cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is successfully created when a new browser window is opened or the browser is restarted.

cases.title: Create Session History File with Restricted Permissions
cases.description: Verify session history file creation behavior when file system permissions are restricted for the directory.

cases.title: Disk Full Error During Session File Creation
cases.description: Verify error handling when a disk full error occurs while attempting to create a new session history file.

opinions.feedback: All requirements have been adequately mapped with test cases covering normal, edge, and abnormal scenarios. No blockers found.
All requirements are comprehensively tested across normal, edge, and abnormal scenarios with well-structured test cases.

analysis.analysis: R-073: Normal - visit a standard link and verify Global History recording; Edge - visit an empty URL or malformed link; Abnormal - history database write failure. R-074: Normal - follow a redirected link and verify final target URL in Global History; Edge - chain of multiple redirects; Abnormal - redirect loop error. R-075: Normal - click a history link to launch in a browser window; Edge - click link while browser is offline; Abnormal - invalid URL schema or missing target. R-076: Normal - delete a single history entry; Edge - delete an already deleted entry; Abnormal - delete operation fails due to locked database. R-077: Normal - delete multiple entries simultaneously and verify removal from display; Edge - select all entries and delete; Abnormal - partial deletion failure. R-078: Normal - clear entire Global History; Edge - clear already empty history; Abnormal - failure during history wipe. R-079: Normal - group history items by Day, Site, and None; Edge - group with empty data set; Abnormal - grouping failure on corrupted entries. R-080: Normal - sort and reverse-sort history columns; Edge - sort empty table; Abnormal - sort failure on mismatched data types. R-081: Normal - resize history columns to show/hide content; Edge - resize columns to minimum or maximum width limits; Abnormal - layout rendering crash on extreme resize. R-082: Normal - show and hide history columns; Edge - hide all columns; Abnormal - failure to persist column visibility state. R-083: Normal - revisit recent sites via Back and Forward dropdown menus; Edge - dropdown when no history exists; Abnormal - menu failure when navigation state is corrupt. R-084: Normal - create a new empty session history file on new window or restart; Edge - file creation with restricted filesystem permissions; Abnormal - disk full error when creating session file.
